title: Insight into the effect of Mg-substitution on the electronic, optoelectronic, and hydrogen storage density of NbH2 fluorite structured: a DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27113-27127
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03949E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Godwin O. Igomah, Favour A. Nelson, Fadhil Faez Sead, Musa Runde, Ismail Hossain, Ayi A. Ayi
First-principles calculations show Mg substitution in NbH2 increases density, lowers TDOS, and enhances optical and dielectric properties, enabling tunable performance for energy and optoelectronic applications.
